instruction: Open the terms and conditions webpage.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to terms and conditions page on Ticketek website. Similar difficulty and interaction pattern to original task. Uses is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify URL contains terms/conditions/legal keywords. No new functions needed - uses existing Chrome getters and metrics.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_active_tab_info) correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome browser
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL to check for 'terms|conditions|legal' keywords
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns dict with 'url' field, metric extracts URL and checks pattern
Expected pattern ['terms|conditions|legal'] is semantically appropriate for verifying navigation to T&C page on Ticketek website
Coverage is complete: checking URL pattern appropriately verifies the navigation instruction
Metric logic correctly returns 1.0 if pattern matches, 0.0 otherwise
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor consideration: get_active_tab_info reloads the page by navigating to URL from accessibility tree, which could theoretically cause redirect issues if T&C page has cache/cookies. However, this is unlikely for static T&C pages and acceptable for this task.
